name: Lake Kel'Theril
summary: Beneath Lake Kel'Theril's ice, ancient ruins hold the spirits of the kaldorei who once lived there. Snow and frozen water cover the remains of their outpost from before the Great Sundering.

sections.title: A Frozen Tomb of the Highborne
sections.body: Lake Kel'Theril lies frozen beneath Winterspring's bitter cold. Shattered pillars and arches rise through the ice and along the snowy banks. They are all that remains of Kel'Theril, an outpost of the ancient Highborne before the Great Sundering broke Kalimdor apart. Even in death, the fallen aristocracy found no rest. Their ghosts and specters still wander the lake, bound to the ruins of their former home.

faq.q: Why is the lake haunted by night elves?
faq.answer: The spirits haunting Lake Kel'Theril are tormented ghosts of the ancient Highborne. When the Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart ten thousand years ago, their civilization collapsed. Their souls remain bound to the icy ruins of their settlement.

faq.q: What ruins stand along the lake's shores?
faq.answer: The crumbling pillars and stonework along the lake belong to the Ruins of Kel'Theril. The ancient kaldorei settlement thrived under the Highborne before the War of the Ancients.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Lake Kel'Theril's specters as a reminder of the ruin wrought by the ancient Highborne's arrogance.
